verdict.rationale: BugSnag is a SaaS error-monitoring service that stores customer data, so whether that data is used for AI training is a fair question. The pack contains no AI-training policy, opt-out, or no-training commitment. The nearest items are adjacent controls: retroactive redaction of sensitive data, an on-premise self-hosted option, and SDK discard rules. None of these is a documented way to stop data being used for model training, so they earn no credit.
